reasoning: Recent New Hampshire-specific polling in the last 45 days shows a close U.S. Senate race, with one University of New Hampshire poll giving Democrat Chris Pappas a narrow 47% to 44% edge over Republican Scott Brown, which is roughly D+3 by margin. A separate report says Cook currently rates the New Hampshire Senate contest as Lean Democratic, consistent with a small Democratic advantage. I did not find a current-cycle New Hampshire presidential poll in the provided results, so the Senate race is the best-supported current margin.

sources.details: University of New Hampshire survey of 1,236 Maine residents found Troy Jackson ahead of Susan Collins 49% to 46% in a general-election Senate matchup; this is not New Hampshire and is therefore only context, not the target race.
